name: @olai/index
//dependencies: @olai/format and nothing else. This package holds the index and no rules: what a query MEANS, which fields a word is looked for in and what order an answer comes back in are all one layer down, and the only things reached for are the three that make a superset sayable — `hayOf` / `documentHayOf` (the text to hold) and `narrowableBy` (which of a query's words may narrow it). The engine is `bun:sqlite`, which is the runtime's own and therefore not a line here; that it is Bun's is why this sits above `format` rather than inside it, since `format` is bundled into a browser.
//devDependencies: @types/bun is the root's; nothing else is needed. The tests and the bench build their corpora with @olai/format's own `./testlib`, which the runtime dependency above already resolves.
